# scc_device_tenant_rule (Resource)

Manages the DeviceTenantRule object via New-DeviceTenantRule / Get-DeviceTenantRule / Set-DeviceTenantRule / Remove-DeviceTenantRule.

## Schema

- `block_unsupported_devices` (String) Maps to the -BlockUnsupportedDevices parameter.
- `exclusion_list` (String) Maps to the -ExclusionList parameter.
